title: High-Register Idiomatic Compounds: Kétélű fegyver and Sarokkő
goal: I can use fixed metaphors such as *kétélű fegyver*, *sarokkő*, *vízválasztó* and *zsákutca*.
I can explain how a physical image stands for an abstract idea.
I can use *mérföldkő* and *zsákutca* in an argument about history.

sections.title: Unit 6: Metaphor, Idiomatic Resonance & Conceptual Blending
body: Metaphor in Hungarian is not mere decorative ornament; it is the fundamental cognitive framework through which abstract concepts, moral dilemmas, and existential conditions are experienced.
In this unit you will learn fixed metaphors (*kétélű fegyver*, *sarokkő*, *vízválasztó*), abstract nouns such as *valóságérzék*, figurative verbs, and the plain style of a text about János Pilinszky.
